conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Michael Turner with the IRS Refund Department. I'm calling regarding your 2023 tax return. Is this Ms. Jessica Parker?
Yes, that's me. I wasn't expecting a call from the IRS. Is something wrong?

No, nothing's wrong. In fact, we've reviewed your recent tax filing and you're eligible for a substantial federal refund due to recent tax relief measures. I just need to verify a few details to process your refund.
Wow, really? I had no idea. What do you need from me?
First, can you confirm your mailing address and the last four digits of your Social Security Number, so I can pull up your file?
Uh, sure. My address is 213 Oak Drive, and the last four digits are 8832.

Thank you, Jessica. Alright, I see your refund amount is $2,780. However, before we can release these funds, the IRS now requires a one-time identity verification fee of $198, as part of anti-fraud regulations implemented this year.
Wait, I have to pay to get my own refund? I've never heard of that before.

I understand your concern, but this is a new IRS protocol to prevent tax fraud. If you do not complete the verification within the next 90 minutes, your refund will be placed on indefinite hold and possibly forfeited to the state.
That sounds serious. So what do I need to do?
You'll need to submit the $198 verification fee today for us to confirm your eligibility and unlock your refund. We accept payments via prepaid Visa gift cards or through Zelle. Which do you prefer?
I guess I can buy a Visa gift card? Where do I get one?

You can purchase one at any major grocery or pharmacy, CVS, Walgreens, or Walmart. Please make sure the amount is exactly $198, and keep the receipt. Once you have the card, call me back with the numbers on the back.
And this is definitely required? I just don't want any trouble with the IRS.
Absolutely. If you don't make this payment today, your refund will be cancelled, and you could also face penalties for failing to comply with federal tax regulations.
Okay, I'll go to the store now. Should I call this number back?

Yes, call this number as soon as you have the card. Do not share the codes with anyone else, as this is a secure IRS process. If you're not able to complete this within the next 60 minutes, I'll have to escalate your file for audit and possible legal review.
Oh, I'll hurry. I really can't afford to lose that refund or get audited.
Thank you for your prompt cooperation, Jessica. Remember, time is of the essence. I'll be waiting for your call to finalize the refund release.
